title: Notice on Binance Futures COIN-M System Upgrade (2026-06-30)
text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures COIN-M is undergoing a temporary system upgrade from  2026-06-30 01:00 (UTC) to 2026-06-30 07:00 (UTC) . There will be a 30 minutes cancel-only phase after the upgrade is complete  at 2026-06-30 07:00 (UTC) .   Please note that  all the services on COIN-M Futures will be suspended  (Market session: PENDING_TRADING) during the upgrade period and will be only resumed at 2026-06-30 07:30 (UTC). It is recommended that users with open positions in COIN-M Futures re-assess their collateral balances and the affected services listed as below prior to the start of upgrade to mitigate against price fluctuations that may occur. Notes: About COIN-M Futures: All services of COIN-M Futures Account (including COIN-M Futures related  trading bots , i.e., Arbitrage Bot and Grid Trading), such as  trading, closing position, order cancellation, asset transfer and liquidation functions  will be suspended during the upgrade period and will be only resumed at 2026-06-30 07:30 (UTC). The  mark price and index price  of COIN-M Futures will be functioning as usual during the upgrade period. However, all open orders (reduce-only, TP/SL or grid orders) which use mark price as trigger price will not be executed despite the mark price having been reached during the upgrade period.  If the users have different  Self Trade Prevention (STP)  settings in USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Futures, the STP setting in COIN-M Futures will be aligned to the setting in USDⓈ-M Futures.  During the cancel-only phase, users are allowed to submit, modify or cancel Post-Only orders only. API users may use GET /dapi/v1/exchangeInfo and UI users can refer to this  page  to check the latest trading status of the COIN-M Futures during the upgrade process.  Assume the upgrade takes 6 hours to complete, below is the trading status of the COIN-M Futures: Timeline Description Trading Status Before 2026-06-30 01:00 (UTC) Before the upgrade TRADING  From 2026-06-30 01:00 (UTC)  to 2026-06-30 07:00 (UTC) COIN-M Futures is undergoing upgrade PENDING_TRADING From 2026-06-30 07:00 (UTC) to 2026-06-30 07:30 (UTC) The cancel-only phase after the upgrade completes TRADING_CANCEL_ONLY After 2026-06-30 07:30 (UTC) Trading function resumes TRADING If the upgrade takes more than 6 hours to complete, a separate announcement will be made. The funding rate cycle at 2026-06-30 08:00 (UTC) will be cancelled in this circumstance (no payment will be incurred). About USDⓈ-M Futures: Trading on USDⓈ-M Futures  will remain  unaffected  during the upgrade period.  Users are not allowed to switch between One-Way Mode and Hedge Mode during this period. About Portfolio Margin Features and trading configurations are not available during the upgrade period, with details as below: Activate or deactivate Portfolio Margin Mode Portfolio Margin Close All function Auto-Exchange Please note that the  Portfolio Margin Close All function  and  Auto-Exchange  functions will  cease to function  during the upgrade period despite the functions having been activated before the upgrade period.  If the Portfolio Margin users  have positions in both USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Futures or deposited collateral into their COIN-M Futures Accounts and subject to liquidation  during the upgrade period,  the open positions and the collateral assets in COIN-M Futures will be liquidated as usual . Please note that it is different from the regular COIN-M Futures, in which the portfolio margin is not activated and the liquidation process is suspended during the upgrade period. The liquidation process for Portfolio Margin users with positions or collateral assets in COIN-M Futures might continue for hours after the upgrade period is complete.  About WebSocket and REST API  The parameters of some USDⓈ-M and COIN-M Futures WebSocket and REST API will be updated.  For more details and updates, please refer to our full  API Changelog . API users are advised to update the API configuration to avoid trading disruptions.  The system upgrade will take approximately 6 hours to complete. A separate announcement will be posted when the upgrade is complete. Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-06-10
